comment: Follow-up automation configuration. The runner (scripts/followup-runner.mjs) is designed for cron/Task Scheduler. Dry-run by default: it prints and logs what WOULD be sent. Pass --send to actually deliver via Resend / WhatsApp Cloud API. Only leads with contact_consent=1 are emailed; WhatsApp messages additionally require whatsapp_consent=1. Every send (or dry-run) is logged in the notifications table for traceability. Adjust hoursBefore/hoursAfter and enable flags to taste. Never enable a workflow whose consent requirements are not met.

whatsapp.note: Enable only after Meta WhatsApp Cloud API is live and an approved opt-in template exists. Reminders use the same approved template constraints as the booking confirmation.
